Payment
The customer shall pay the invoice.
The supplier will deliver the goods.
The contractor agrees to maintain the equipment.
The report is required to include the total.
The customer shall not share the data.
The customer must wait unless the schedule states otherwise.
Fees are as set forth in Exhibit B.
Costs are subject to Schedule A.
Prices are subject to Exhibit C.
Work is performed in accordance with the statement.
The agreement is effective 2026-04-01.
